prompt_en: Core concept lock: 카리나 메이드 흡혈귀. Treat every generated subject, action, lighting, and camera detail as support for this concept, not a replacement. Create a conceptual photograph in the style of environmental portrait photography. Subject and state: a maid-cafe cosplay performer with a classic elegant presence, long black twin-tail hair with a dark headband and ribbon accents, delicate makeup with glossy lips, a calm intense gaze wearing frilled apron maid-cafe costume; action and prop: pressed near a doorway, watching a corridor from shadow, a compact mirror; make the pose, gaze, expression, hand placement, and immediate intention readable, with nearby props and background details supporting the action. Scene and location: inside a pastel maid-cafe interior; show clear spatial depth, environmental structure, foreground, midground, and background cues. Camera and composition: a 2000s compact digital camera, eye-level three-quarter view, frame-within-a-frame using windows or doorways, upper-body framing, a 50mm standard lens, precise focus on the eyes; define subject scale, pose visibility, platform-safe frame edges, perspective, focus behavior, and any motion treatment clearly. Lighting: chiaroscuro window light with deep shadows, cross-lighting from both sides, ring light with circular catchlights, exposure retaining deep shadows, neon edges wrapping around the subject; make shadow direction, highlights, reflected light, exposure balance, and atmosphere feel like a real photographic capture. Color and mood: luxury black-and-gold palette, occult noir mood; keep the palette, emotional tone, and world context coherent with the subject and setting. Texture, format, and finish: natural skin texture preserved, delicate makeup with glossy lips, frilled apron maid-cafe costume, vertical 4:5 social portrait aspect ratio, photoreal cosplay realism on a real person; render skin, hair, fabric, metal, glass, makeup, and accessories with accurate material detail. Prioritize a specific, image-ready photographic result over a vague style summary. Additional requirements: adult maid-cafe costume styling with frilled apron details; vampire reinterpreted as an immortal nocturnal aristocrat: poised, refined, ageless, and defined by predatory stillness rather than a horror-movie monster pose; keep the role outfit readable; the vampire layer should alter posture, light, reflection behavior, room cues, and nearby objects rather than replacing the costume with a generic gothic doll dress; make at least two positive, visible non-graphic vampire identity anchors appear in the frame beyond black lace: a camera-visible absent or mismatched reflection, daylight barrier, moonlit pallor, bat-like shadow, withered flowers, coffin-like geometry, antique portrait, ruby eye catchlight, ruby jewelry, or a small cup of dark red wine; at least one vampire anchor must be attached to the subject or placed immediately beside the face, hand, phone, mirror, badge, jewelry, or foreground reflection; do not leave all vampire cues as distant background props; the vampire identity should be the first reading within a couple of seconds, before the job costume, role genre, or ordinary cosplay/fashion reading; do not rely on absence cues alone; generic gothic fashion, ordinary moody lifestyle portraiture, or plain mine horror is not enough to satisfy the vampire concept; use one restrained crimson accent only as eye catchlight, jewelry, medical cross, flower, or light, never as visible blood; the mouth stays relaxed and closed with no teeth shown; no visible blood, no bared fangs, no bite wounds, no visible victims, no gore, no feeding scene, and no graphic violence; the maid outfit stays clearly readable, while an open compact mirror faces the camera and shows an empty room, delayed silhouette, or mismatched reflection instead of a normal reflection; service posture becomes unnaturally still at the doorway, as if the room has gone silent around an immortal nocturnal guest; the subject's lit face and hands must be visible in the same frame as the open mirror, so the viewer can instantly compare the real maid against the failed reflection; add a positive vampire anchor near the subject, such as bat-wing-shaped lace shadow crossing the wall art close to the shoulder or a tiny ruby eye catchlight, so it is not only a gothic maid portrait; the vampire cue must share the first-read area with the face, throat, hand, choker, mirror edge, or foreground reflection rather than sitting only in background decor; the ruby, reflection, bat-like shadow, or moon-pale cue must be visible before the image reads as ordinary maid cosplay. Inspired by the described styling and vibe; an original adult fictional person, not an exact likeness of any real individual. Let the final frame keep one quiet imperfection, shared light across subject and setting, and a small material trace, so it feels discovered by a real photographer rather than assembled as a clean concept image.
prompt_ko: 핵심 컨셉 잠금: 카리나 메이드 흡혈귀. 아래의 피사체, 동작, 조명, 카메라 디테일은 이 컨셉을 대체하지 않고 보조해야 한다. 콘셉트 포토로 렌더링할 환경 인물 사진. 중심 피사체와 상태: 클래식하고 우아한 인상의 검은 헤드밴드와 리본을 곁들인 긴 검은 트윈테일 헤어 글로시한 입술을 더한 섬세한 메이크업 차분하지만 강렬한 시선의 프릴 앞치마 메이드 카페 코스튬을 입은 메이드 카페 코스프레 모델; 동작과 소품: 문가 그림자에 붙어 복도를 지켜보는, 콤팩트 거울; 피사체의 자세, 시선, 표정, 손동작, 즉각적인 동작 의도가 한눈에 읽히게 하고, 주변 소품과 배경 요소는 그 행동을 설명하도록 배치한다. 장면과 장소: 파스텔 톤 메이드 카페 인테리어에서; 공간의 깊이, 바닥/벽/하늘 또는 실내 구조, 전경/중경/후경의 거리감을 분명히 보여준다. 카메라와 구도: 2000년대 콤팩트 디지털카메라, 눈높이 3/4 측면 시점, 창문과 문틈을 활용한 프레임 속 프레임, 상반신 중심 프레이밍, 50mm 표준 렌즈, 눈에 정확히 맞은 초점; 피사체 크기, 포즈 가시성, 플랫폼 안전 프레임, 프레임 가장자리, 원근감, 초점 위치, 움직임 처리를 명확히 한다. 조명: 깊은 그림자의 키아로스쿠로 창문빛, 양쪽에서 교차하는 빛, 눈동자에 원형 반사가 생기는 링라이트, 짙은 그림자가 남아 있는 노출, 피사체 윤곽을 따라 번지는 네온 엣지; 그림자 방향, 하이라이트, 반사광, 노출 균형, 대기감을 실제 촬영처럼 보이게 한다. 색감과 분위기: 검정과 금색의 럭셔리 팔레트, 오컬트 누아르의 어둡고 불온한 정서; 색 대비, 감정 톤, 세계관 맥락이 피사체와 장소에 맞아야 한다. 질감과 마감: 자연스러운 피부 질감 보존, 글로시한 입술을 더한 섬세한 메이크업, 프릴 앞치마 메이드 카페 코스튬, 세로 4:5 소셜 포트레이트 비율, 실제 인물이 입은 코스프레처럼 자연스러운 포토리얼리즘; 피부, 머리카락, 천, 금속, 유리, 메이크업, 액세서리 같은 소재 단서를 실제 질감으로 표현한다. 이미지 생성 시 요구사항을 빠뜨리지 말고, 막연한 스타일 요약보다 구체적인 사진 결과를 우선한다. 추가 요구사항: adult maid-cafe costume styling with frilled apron details;
